caption: The drawing depicts a bust of a man, showing only his head and upper torso. The man has curly dark brown hair and prominent sideburns. He is dressed in a dark, possibly navy or black, coat with a wide collar. Underneath the coat, he wears a light yellow shirt with a high collar and a greenish-yellow scarf wrapped around his neck. The bust has no visible arms, ending in rounded, stylized forms near the shoulders and a decorative base that features coiled, volute-like elements. The facial features are clearly defined, with brown eyes, straight eyebrows, a straight nose, and lips gently closed. The background is plain and off-white, with no additional objects or scenery visible. The drawing employs shading and color gradients to convey depth and texture, particularly in the textures on the coat and the man's hair.
title: Figurehead from "Bartholomew Gosnold"
